method: Generic Cargo release (ThinLTO, codegen-units1) for engine APIs; rustc -O for isolated speculative kernels. taskset CPU2, no concurrent compilers or sibling timing. Engine API screen two arm-order passes (B,C then C,B),5 batchmeans per arm per pass,minimum20ms per batch. Target/direct query kernels cover7families x3densities; legal4modes on opening+6VPSpositions. Standalone kernels5batchmeans per arm minimum12ms per batch. Primary geometry covers all5041unique deltas with equal-noinline function boundaries; diagonal-only/unequal-boundary versions are diagnostics excluded from general comparisons. Ranges are batch means, not request tail latencies or confidence intervals.

speculative_kernels.method: Both algebra and table functions #[inline(never)] with identical black_box on coordinate inputs and dataset. idx=(i*173)%5041 enumerates all5041 deltas; table reference blackboxed; tasksetCPU2quietwindow. Prior diagonal-only result retained as diagnostic, not general measurement.
speculative_kernels.limits: Uniform coordinate-difference primitive; warm10082byte direction+distance table, not engine query distribution. Main current direction-only inlined helper and engine cache pressure can differ.

geometry_diagnostic.method: Both algebra and table functions #[inline(never)] with black_box on coordinate inputs; table reference blackboxed;1000queriespermeasurement call; same pinnedCPU2quietwindow. Prior unequal-boundary result is discarded.
geometry_diagnostic.limits: Diagonal-only: coefficients173 and31 congruent modulo71 produce71distinct df==dr deltas repeated1000times. No mixed-query or engine speed claim.
